shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽坐在考桌前，举起一张空白答卷
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet sits at an exam desk, holds up a blank answer sheet and waves.
shots.narration: 二十五道判断题，你能答对几道？
overlay: 进场考核：二十五道判断题

shots.scene: 一行图标：梯子、电钻、安全帽、吊车、灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a ladder, a power drill, a hard hat, a crane and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子、电动工具、吊装、用电、消防。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白简历走进一间考场
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into an exam room holding a blank resume.

shots.narration: 面试之前，先要过一场笔试。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits down and picks up a pen.
shots.narration: 笔试过了，才能进下一轮。

shots.scene: 空白试卷旁浮现分值图示
shots.prompt_en: A blank exam paper with simple number blocks floating beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 一共二十五题，每题两分，满分五十。

shots.scene: 进度条在八成处插一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: A long progress bar with a small flag planted at four fifths of its length. No people.
shots.narration: 得分达到八成才算通过。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂住答案页，自己先答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers an answer page with his hand and answers on his own first.
shots.narration: 答案在最后，先自己做，再对答案。
